attempts.summary: Built a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster (node1, node2, node3) from scratch on CentOS Stream 10, populated it with application data (appdb.orders), then added node4 as a fourth member which received all existing data via SST (mariabackup) and now accepts writes that replicate to the other three members. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol on all four nodes sequentially, preserving quorum throughout, with each node proven to have restarted (changed boot_id) and recovered full cluster membership, service health, and data integrity afterward.
